C0705.title: South Korea’s Culture Ministry Requests Police Investigation into BTS Concert Ticket Scalping
keywords: Ministry of Culture Sports and Tourism
C0705.summary: On March 11, 2026, South Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism said it had found 1,868 BTS concert ticket-scalping posts on major secondhand platforms and referred four suspected high-price resale cases involving 105 tickets to police. The ministry also warned that mobile QR codes, wristbands, and random identity checks could prevent scalped-ticket buyers from entering the venue, and said amended anti-scalping rules would take effect that August.
